lines.text: An opaque object that holds the raw results of a scan.
When your app completes a scan session by calling ``RoomCaptureSession/stop()``, the framework provides your app with raw scan results in one of the following ways:
- The ``RoomCaptureViewDelegate/captureView(shouldPresent:error:)-myzs`` callback for an app that scans rooms using the framework-provided view (``RoomCaptureView``)
- The ``RoomCaptureSessionDelegate/captureSession(_:didEndWith:error:)-981ii`` callback for an app that implements its own room-scanning view
With an instance of this structure, your app can:
- Process the raw data into a detailed captured room object (``CapturedRoom``) by creating a room builder (``RoomBuilder``) and calling its ``RoomBuilder/capturedRoom(from:)`` function.
- Serialize to an encoder object, for example, to defer processing to a later date or to defer processing to another device.
